description: This Java source file defines a class 'Sending', which manages the process of sending signals or messages within the Ditto services connectivity infrastructure. It handles asynchronous responses, acknowledgements, error handling, and monitoring of message transmission outcomes.

classes.name: Sending
classes.description: A class representing an ongoing sending operation for signals/messages, managing responses, acknowledgements, and failure handling.

methods.name: monitorAndAcknowledge
methods.description: Attaches monitoring and acknowledgment logic to the asynchronous response of a message send operation.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Determines whether to generate an acknowledgment based on the response and sending context.

methods.name: getNullAckException
methods.description: Creates a MessageSendingFailedException indicating no acknowledgment was received.

methods.name: monitor
methods.description: Performs monitoring actions based on the response, such as acknowledgment or live response handling.

methods.name: isAcknowledgement
methods.description: Checks if a response is an acknowledgement.

methods.name: isTargetIssuesLiveResponse
methods.description: Checks if the auto-acknowledgment target issues live responses.

methods.name: monitorLiveResponse
methods.description: Initiates monitoring for a live response.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions that occur during sending, performing monitoring and converting exceptions to acknowledgements if applicable.

methods.name: monitorSendFailure
methods.description: Logs and monitors failure scenarios during message sending.

methods.name: convertExceptionToAcknowledgementOrNull
methods.description: Converts an exception into an acknowledgement if auto acknowledgment is enabled.

methods.name: getRootCause
methods.description: Recursively extracts the root cause of a throwable, especially for nested CompletionExceptions.
